definitions.explanation: A substance added to soil to supply nutrients that promote plant growth, including both organic and chemical types.

examples.japanese: {畑|はたけ}に{肥料|ひりょう}をまく。
examples.english: To spread fertilizer on the field.

examples.japanese: {有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう}を{使|つか}って{野菜|やさい}を{育|そだ}てる。
examples.english: To grow vegetables using organic fertilizer.

examples.japanese: {肥料|ひりょう}の{与|あた}えすぎに{注意|ちゅうい}する。

notes:
USAGE:
{肥料|ひりょう} is the general term for fertilizer. In gardening and agriculture, choosing the right type is important for plant health.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{肥料|ひりょう}をまく/{施|ほどこ}す (spread/apply fertilizer)
・{肥料|ひりょう}を{与|あた}える (give fertilizer)

TYPES OF FERTILIZER:
・{有機|ゆうき}{肥料|ひりょう} (organic fertilizer)
・{化学|かがく}{肥料|ひりょう}/{化成|かせい}{肥料|ひりょう} (chemical fertilizer)
・{堆肥|たいひ} (compost)
・{液体|えきたい}{肥料|ひりょう}/{液肥|えきひ} (liquid fertilizer)

RELATED TERMS:
・{施肥|せひ} (fertilization - the act)
・{追肥|ついひ} (additional fertilizing)
・{元肥|もとごえ} (base fertilizer)
